description: Standard transient for Ti-6Al-4V, 316L and AlSi10Mg

rosenthal.assumptions: Constant preheat properties; conduction only; discrete liquidus extent; no keyhole correction.

goldak.assumptions: Constant preheat properties; conduction only; discrete liquidus extent; no keyhole correction.

alsi10mg.key.assumptions: SI internal units; beam diameter is 1/e^2 intensity diameter.
No resolved momentum, Marangoni flow, evaporation, recoil, VOF, keyhole or pores.
Estimated material laws; fixed reference density conserves mass on a stationary grid.
Uniform effective powder, irreversible conductivity densification; no resolved powder particles.

Gaussian penetration equals layer thickness, independent of mesh. Cell-integrated source uses two time quadrature nodes; thermal evolution remains first-order Euler. Absorbed power normalized over represented domain.
Transient layer activation uses whole cells selected by their centers; source surface clipping does not implement cut-cell mass or conduction. Inspect numerical resolution diagnostics when available.

Geometry is the molten-domain extent at the earliest maximum volume over accepted timesteps; playback is sparse and multi-track pools may be disconnected. Sampling loss does not bound timestep or mesh error.
Cross section is the maximum YZ grid section; it is not scan-normal for rotated scans.
R = -dT/dt / |grad T| at linearly reconstructed cooling liquidus crossings; gradient vectors are interpolated in time. G, R, G×R are separately event-averaged; G <= 1e-6 K/m is excluded.
Ma and laser-travel Pe are screening numbers, not resolved velocities.
Thermal history is input for subsequent mechanics; no residual stress, distortion or cracking prediction.
rawValues.alsi10mg.key.confidenceReason: estimated material data and unresolved flow; no independent experimental validation.

alsi10mg.key.fieldOverlapDiagnostics.note: Single track simulation; inter-track overlap requires >= 2 tracks.

limitations: Geometric screening only; no pore probability, porosity estimate, or certification.
Requires local single-track width and penetration depth for an aligned semi-elliptical cross-section.
Ignores local pool fluctuations, track registration, powder packing, and remelting history.
Accuracy depends on supplied geometry; Rosenthal-derived dimensions can fail this screen.
No Ti-6Al-4V-specific correction or universal keyhole/balling threshold is applied.

lackOfFusion.reason: Only the idealized elliptical overlap condition is evaluated.

keyhole.reason: Aspect ratio D/W >= 1.0 indicates unstable transition regime.

balling.reason: L/W ratio 1.00 < π indicates stable continuous track without capillary breakup.

gasPore.reason: Gas inventory, transport, and pore nucleation are not resolved.

porosity.reason: Geometry screening does not predict volumetric porosity.

provenance.title: Harkin et al. (2023), Equation 5
provenance.use: Semi-elliptical overlap criterion; empirical material-specific correction excluded.

provenance.title: Yadroitsev et al. (2010)
provenance.use: Rayleigh-Plateau capillary instability for single-track balling (L/W > π).

provenance.title: King et al. (2014) & Cunningham et al. (2019)
provenance.use: Aspect ratio D/W > 1.5 for keyhole instability and vapor depression collapse porosity.
